title: Unlock keybinding customisation and stop Ctrl+C aborting the agent
description: Enables ~/.claude/keybindings.json, and restores the 2.0.x behaviour where Ctrl+C exits rather than interrupting the agent loop — Escape still interrupts.

sites.description: The gate on keybinding customisation. Optional: on 2.1.280 upstream already ships it as `H("…",!0)`, so there is nothing to force. Kept so the site is noticed if it is ever gated again.
The Global binding table's "ctrl+c". The transcript table also binds ctrl+c, to transcript:exit — matching on the value as well as the key is what keeps this off it.
